formats.name: Ordered sequence
formats.description: Drags four to seven procedure steps into the order they must actually be performed in to resolve the incident correctly.

step_count.description: Number of steps to arrange. More steps means a larger search space.

labels_hint_order.description: When false, labels give no ordering cue, raising difficulty.

decoy_steps.description: Extra plausible-but-wrong steps added to the pool. More decoys raise difficulty.

formats.name: Fill in the blanks
formats.description: Reads a config snippet or command and fills in the one to four missing values that would make it correct and safe.

blank_count.description: Number of blanks to fill. Each additional blank raises cognitive load.

input_mode.description: free_text removes the hint list, requiring recall rather than recognition.

surrounding_noise.description: When true, surrounding config lines contain irrelevant distractor values.

formats.name: Dial and allocate
formats.description: Turns a numeric dial to set a resource allocation — such as replica count or memory limit — within the constraints shown on screen.

tolerance_pct.description: How far from the exact answer still counts as correct. Lower is harder.

table_complete.description: When false, the cost or impact table is partially hidden, requiring estimation.

second_constraint.description: When true, a second binding constraint is added, narrowing the valid range.

formats.name: Visual wiring
formats.description: Draws connections between architecture components on a canvas to restore the correct traffic flow after a misconfiguration.

component_count.description: Number of components to wire. Each extra component adds connection candidates.

connection_points_highlighted.description: When false, valid connection targets are not highlighted, requiring unaided recall.

formats.name: Evidence selection
formats.description: Scans a scrollable log or metrics panel and selects exactly the lines that prove the root cause of the current incident.

distractor_count.description: Number of plausible-but-wrong lines mixed into the output. More distractors raise difficulty.

distractor_plausibility.description: high means distractors are topically related errors that require domain knowledge to reject.

output_lines.description: Total lines in the log panel. More lines mean more scanning before finding evidence.
